# Repositorio Institucional CONICET Digital

> Open-access institutional repository for Argentine scientific research managed by CONICET (National Council for Scientific and Technical Research).

CONICET Digital is Argentina's primary digital archive for research publications and data, providing free access to scientific outputs from CONICET researchers and affiliated institutions. The repository supports open science principles and research data management across multiple disciplines including paleobotany, phylogenetics, and environmental sciences.

## Key Topics

## Core Repository Services

- [Repositorio Institucional CONICET Digital](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar): CONICET Digital institutional repository for open-access scientific research
- [Buscar](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/discover): Search interface for CONICET Digital research publications
- [Listar por Autores](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/explorar-autores): Browse CONICET researchers alphabetically by author name
- [Lista de comunidades](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/community-list): Directory of CONICET research centers and scientific institutions

## About & Information

- [CONICET Digital](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/acerca-de/conicet-digital): About CONICET Digital institutional repository and its mission
- [Ayuda](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/ayuda): Help guide for CONICET Digital repository usage and access
- [Datos de Investigación](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/ayuda/datos-de-investigacion): Documentation on research data management and repository guidelines

## News & Updates

- [Noticias](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/novedades-2/noticias): News and updates about CONICET Digital repository activities
- [Boletines](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/novedades-2/boletines): Newsletters with research indicators and repository updates

## Support & Contact

- [Contacto](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/contacto): Contact information for CONICET Digital technical office
- [Equipo](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/wp/acerca-de/equipo): CONICET Digital team members and organizational structure

## Optional: Research Examples

- [Early Diversification of Southern Cypresses](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/handle/11336/283675): Paleobotany research on Late Cretaceous Antarctic fossils
- [Análisis filogenético del complejo Degeeriella](https://ri.conicet.gov.ar/handle/11336/283674): Phylogenetic analysis of louse taxonomy and host classification
